start: Android phone with a paired Wear OS watch, MettleUp not on the watch

steps.action: Open Settings, Phone and watch, tap 'Your watch'
user_sees: Title 'Your watch'
Row 'MettleUp works on your watch too' with 'Install on watch'
Switch 'Open MettleUp on my watch', 'When you start a workout, your watch opens MettleUp too'
must_not: The install row missing while a watch is paired

steps.action: Tap 'MettleUp works on your watch too'
user_sees: 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: Nothing said after the tap
Two Play Store openings after a fast double tap

steps.action: Install on the watch, come back to the page
user_sees: The row line reads 'Installed'
must_not: 'Install on watch' still shown after install

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone
user_sees: MettleUp opens on the watch with the rest timer
must_not: The watch opening while 'Open MettleUp on my watch' is off

start: Settings, Phone and watch, tap 'Health apps', Health Connect installed, access not given

steps.action: Look at the Health Connect row
user_sees: Title 'Health apps'
'Send each finished workout and its calories to Google Health and Samsung Health, through Health Connect.'
Button 'Connect'
must_not: A Stop button before anything is allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Connect' and allow in Health Connect's screen
user_sees: 'On. Each workout you finish goes to Health Connect as strength training, with its calories (an estimate), so Google Health and Samsung Health can show it.'
must_not: 'On' while Health Connect refused

user_sees: The workout shows in Health Connect as strength training
must_not: The workout sent twice
A workout on demo data sent

start: Settings, Phone and watch, tap 'Widgets', no widget placed

user_sees: Title 'Widgets'
'Home-screen widgets', 'Your next workout and your week, on your home screen.'
Buttons 'Add Next workout' and 'Add This week'; with a gym, 'Add Gym right now' and 'How busy your gym is now. Tap it to check in.'
must_not: 'Add Gym right now' with no gym joined

steps.action: Tap 'Add Next workout' and place it
user_sees: Caption '1 on your home screen. Add another, or long-press your home screen â†’ Widgets â†’ MettleUp.'
must_not: The count not changing after the widget is placed

start: Your watch page, watch not connected

user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected. Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A message saying the Play Store opened

start: Health apps page, Health Connect not installed or old

user_sees: 'Install or update Health Connect from the Play Store first.' or 'Health Connect is not available on this phone.'
must_not: A Connect button that does nothing
A crash

user_sees: A way to open Health Connect's own page
must_not: Connect again doing nothing with no word

steps.action: Open the Phone and watch group
user_sees: A note that this is not yet on iPhone
must_not: Rows that open empty pages on iPhone

start: Health apps page, Health Connect on

user_sees: The row says sending stopped and that workouts already sent stay in Health Connect
must_not: The next workout still sent

steps.action: Tap 'Stop and remove MettleUp's access', answer yes
user_sees: The removed line; everything shows off
must_not: Any permission still held by MettleUp after the yes

user_sees: The ask before sending past workouts
must_not: Past workouts sent without asking

start: Health apps page, on demo data or with sleep linked

steps.action: Turn on sending while using demo data
user_sees: 'Nothing to send: workouts on demo data never leave your phone.'
must_not: A demo workout in Health Connect

user_sees: The sleep line
must_not: Sleep sent anywhere off the phone

steps.action: Check a weight typed in MettleUp after a scale weigh-in
user_sees: The typed weight kept
must_not: A typed weight changed by a scale reading
